description:
The marketing team needs to identify hotels located in the historic center of Rome for a new campaign. 

1. Connect to the 'demodb' database in OrientDB Studio (User: root, Pass: GymAnything123!).
2. Create a Spatial Index named 'Hotels.Location' on the 'Hotels' class covering the 'Latitude' and 'Longitude' properties using the LUCENE engine.
3. Create a new property called 'MarketingZone' (String) on the 'Hotels' class.
4. Run a spatial query to update all hotels strictly WITHIN the following rectangular polygon (representing central Rome) by setting their 'MarketingZone' property to 'HistoricCenter':
   
   Polygon Coordinates (Longitude Latitude order):
   (12.48 41.89, 12.51 41.89, 12.51 41.91, 12.48 41.91, 12.48 41.89)

   (Note: Hotel Artemide should be inside this zone; hotels in other cities should not.)
